name: Eris
description: Eris, the secretary: her status poses, a conversation typed to her, and the soul text and orb other plugins reuse.

endue.eris.float.description: Whether Eris floats over other apps: while the desk is not in front (auto), all the time (always), or never. Never makes the shortcut bring the desk forward instead.

endue.eris.shortcut.description: The key that summons Eris from any app (Option+Enter on macOS), read when the desk starts; DESK_ERIS_SHORTCUT overrides it. The tray's Talk to Eris works whatever the key.
